---
title: Morphological analysis of historical languages
---



## Extending syntactic analysis

I'm using [DSPy](https://dspy.ai) to extend syntactic analyses with contextually disambiguated morphological anlayses:

- [tabulaedspy](https://neelsmith.github.io/tabulaedspy/): a Python package leveraging LLMs with `dspy` to add Latin morphological anlayses to `arsgrammatica` tokens.
- *kanonesdspy*: a Python package leveraging LLMs with `dspy` to add ancient Greek morphological anlayses to `grammatike` tokens. (*Not yet publicly released.*)


## Extracting information from spaCy

- [latincymorph](https://github.com/neelsmith/latincymorph): get morphological data from spaCy analysis of Latin texts into a structured object format.
